title: VisualArtifactSpec 1.0: Evaluating Visual Artifacts under Task Specifications
abstract: arXiv:2611.21382v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Visual artifact tasks test agents' ability to translate task specifications and source materials into outputs that meet practical needs. Evaluation across artifact families helps distinguish broadly applicable authoring capabilities from strengths confined to a particular medium. We introduce VisualArtifactSpec 1.0 (VAS), a benchmark of 211 creation and modification tasks spanning presentations, static graphics, animations and videos, and web interfaces. Each task specifies authoring objectives, source materials, constraints, and deliverables. Existing benchmarks provide limited support for systematically evaluating how authoring choices suit different audiences, purposes, and media across artifact families. VAS evaluates two aspects separately: Task Fulfillment verifies explicit requirements and applicable functionality, while Artifact Performance assesses Content, Organization, Visuals, and Delivery. translated_title: VisualArtifactSpec 1.0：在任务规范下评估视觉制品
translated_abstract: 视觉制品任务测试智能体将任务规范和源素材转化为满足实际需求的输出的能力。跨制品类型的评估有助于区分广泛适用的创作能力与仅局限于特定媒介的优势。我们提出了 VisualArtifactSpec 1.0（VAS），这是一个包含 211 个创作与修改任务的基准，涵盖演示文稿、静态图形、动画与视频以及网页界面。每个任务都规定了创作目标、源素材、约束条件和交付成果。现有基准在系统评估创作选择如何适配不同受众、目的和媒介方面提供的支持有限。VAS 分别评估两个维度：任务履行度验证明确的要求和适用的功能，而制品表现评估内容、组织结构、视觉效果和呈现方式。针对具体任务的评分锚点……
tldr: 提出 VisualArtifactSpec 1.0（VAS）基准，通过 211 个涵盖演示文稿、图形、动画视频和网页界面的创作与修改任务，从任务履行度和制品表现两个维度系统评估智能体在任务规范下创作视觉作品的能力。
en_tdlr: VisualArtifactSpec 1.0 (VAS) is a benchmark of 211 creation and modification tasks spanning presentations, static graphics, animations/videos, and web interfaces, which separately evaluates visual artifact authoring via Task Fulfillment and Artifact Performance dimensions.
